title: 27-frontier H27 sheaf solver

frontier_identification.meaning: the nine vertical fibres are the same Hesse cell seen in the three pair-boundary projections

solver_reading.local_patches: 45 H27 triples = 36 old W33 shell triples + 9 new Heisenberg fibres
solver_reading.overlaps: each frontier point is in exactly 5 patches: 4 old + 1 new
solver_reading.boundary: the 18 BT1788 nonconcurrent ternary tables are not claimed to be raw GQ(2,4) lines under the naive frontier labelling; BT1790 supplies the corrected 27-point boundary geometry to which those tables should be materialized/projection-matched.

conclusion: The 27-frontier object is exactly the H27/Payne boundary: GQ(2,4)=SRG(27,10,1,5), with Schlaefli dual complement SRG(27,16,10,8). This realizes the suspected H27/SRG connection while preserving the index correction that the raw W(3,3) 27-shell is only 8-regular.
